target.title: improve: reduce repeated session startup scans
target.body:
Related: #99190

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long-lived session transcripts could still be touched with full-file scans on run startup paths even when only the first JSONL header line was needed, and where large AGENTS.md bootstrap content could be re-scanned for the same policy digest every turn.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the no-assistant session reset guard bounded to the transcript header instead of reading the full JSONL file, while preserving the existing fail-closed behavior for corrupt headers. It also caches AGENTS.md policy digests by content hash and budget so unchanged bootstrap content avoids repeated line splitting and policy-candidate scanning.

This intentionally does not replace SessionManager cold-open parsing with a tail-only reader yet; that path also restores model/thinking state, retained compaction tails, leaf controls, labels, and mutation-safe transcript state, so it needs a separate indexed or equivalence-proven design.

AI-assisted: yes.

## User Impact

Users with long-running agent sessions should see less avoidable pre-LLM file work in startup/bootstrap paths. Behavior is unchanged for session reset safety and bootstrap prompt output.

## Evidence

- node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/session-manager-init.test.ts
- node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers.buildbootstrapcontextfiles.test.ts
- git diff --check
